name: com.furrowforms/furrow-forms
description: Form backend an agent can run end to end: register, provision a site's forms, generate snippets, filter spam, verify signed webhooks.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer frw_… token from app.furrowforms.com (Settings → Tokens) or minted by the agent via POST https://api.furrowforms.com/api/register. Omit to use OAuth (dynamic client registration supported).

environmentVariables.name: FURROW_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: frw_… API token. Create one at app.furrowforms.com → Settings → Tokens, or let the agent register via the API.
